title: Pure Joy Stunning Three Story Home with Carriage | Scenic Stays
h1: Pure Joy Stunning Three Story Home with Carriage
meta_description: Come discover the wonders of Pure Joy...in every sense of the word!  This beautiful beach home with carriage house is nestled among Seagrove
description_expanded: Come discover the wonders of Pure Joy...in every sense of the word!  This beautiful beach home with carriage house is nestled among Seagrove's most desirable neighborhoods. 160 N Andalusia Avenue sits steps away from the sugar-white sand & emerald green waters.  This home will not disappoint...with 2 neighborhood pools, one of which is directly across the street,  and a tennis court This 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home with a 1 bedroom, 1 bath Carriage house, will soon be your favorite Scenic 30A vacation spot!  Upon arrival, guests will notice ample parking for 4 vehicles in the long driveway. Surrounded by the sights & sounds of nature, you are sure to enjoy both the peace & privacy, while still being close to all the action & activities 30A has to offer!  Cozy up around the outdoor fire pit & seating area after a long day at the beach!  Or enjoy one of the many screened-in porches...perfect for coffee or cocktails morning, noon, & night!  This large outdoor space also features a built-in gas grill for those daytime barbecues or for nights you're looking to stay in to spend time with family & friends. Both the main & carriage house offer beautiful fully stocked kitchens outfitted with granite countertops & all updated stainless steel appliances.  The main also includes a wine cooler, spacious island, & a breakfast bar providing 4 additional seats. This coastal chic home sleeps 12 comfortably with 3 king-size beds & custom built bunks in the main house & another king-size bed in the carriage.  There are TVs in every bedroom, as well as both living areas.  The master bedroom offers a private screened-in porch & a balcony off the 3rd-floor bedroom.  Suitable for families of all ages, kids can enjoy the board games, puzzles, & books provided.  Don't miss out on all the amazing amenities this home has to offer...unforgettable memories await!! Guests under the age of 25 must be accompanied by an adult chaperone throughout their stay. Parties, events, pets, smoking are not permitted on the property. PLEASE NOTE:  If any of the 12 beach chairs are damaged, lost, or stolen there will be a $200 charge per chair to replace.
